title: fix(cli): os package publish sends the manifest's listing tags, and uses a top-level tagline only as a missing description
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuVpEmthvkRbuHGjC6oSQZvd)_

Fixes #27364

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: follow-up owed — content/docs/deployment/marketplace-handbook.mdx, content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：`os package publish` 现在把清单里的 `tags` 原样发给云端；警告改口：`publisher`、`isStarter` 由平台决定、作者写了不生效（不再说「暂未携带」）；顶层 `tagline` 只在没有 description 时充当 description，否则不发并提示。
- **为什么改**：云端发布接口已能校验并保存 `tags`（cloud#3361），CLI 还在丢弃它，警告也说错了原因；`tagline` 云端没有这一列，一直白发。
- **风险与回滚**：只动 CLI 一个命令的请求体与警告文案；超长或过多的标签由云端 400 拒收并原样打印，CLI 不自设上限。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/cli/src/commands/package/publish.ts`（`pkgBody.tags` 与 tagline/description 那一段、`uncarriedManifestWarnings`）；`packages/cli/test/package-publish-uncarried-manifest-keys.test.ts`。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit test/package-publish-uncarried-manifest-keys.test.ts`，预期 14 个用例全绿。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`packages/cli/src/commands/package/publish.ts`, one command:

- **`tags` is sent.** When `objectstack.manifest.json` declares `tags`, the package POST carries `tags` as written. The hosted route owns the shape and the bounds; the CLI keeps no copy of them and pre-checks nothing, so a refused list comes back as the server's 400 and is printed as the server wrote it (the existing failure path). An absent key leaves the stored tags alone; `[]` clears them. `tags` leaves `UNCARRIED_MANIFEST_KEYS`.
- **Warning wording.** `publisher` and `isStarter` get their own warning: decided by the platform, an author's value has no effect, so publish does not send them. ⛔ Neither is ever sent. `preview` keeps the "hosted catalog does not carry yet" warning with the tracking link; `visibility` keeps its flag warning.
- **Top-level `tagline`.** With no `--description` flag and no manifest `description`, the trimmed tagline is sent as `description`. Otherwise the tagline is not sent, and a warning names it (dropping an authored key silently is the defect this module's warnings exist for). The per-locale `translations.LOCALE.tagline` path is unchanged.

Importers of the two exported constants: `UNCARRIED_MANIFEST_KEYS` and `CATALOG_SEND_ISSUE` are imported only by `packages/cli/test/package-publish-uncarried-manifest-keys.test.ts` (repo-wide grep at the branch head).

One changeset, `@objectstack/cli` patch.

## Tests

`packages/cli/test/package-publish-uncarried-manifest-keys.test.ts` drives the real command (`PackagePublish.run`) against a stubbed `fetch` and reads the request body it sends:

- tags: sent as written; `[]` sent; no key when undeclared; 21 over-long tags reach the wire unchanged, and the server's 400 message reaches the output, exit 1, no version POST.
- tagline: becomes `description` when none is given; not sent and named in a warning when the manifest or the flag gives one; per-locale tagline untouched.
- warnings: `publisher`/`isStarter` platform-decided and never sent; `preview` still not carried, with the link; `visibility` separate; quiet when only sent keys are declared.
- the schema-key partition moves `tags` to SENT.

## Acceptance notes

- **Docs now stale (outside this card's file surface, not edited here).** `content/docs/deployment/marketplace-handbook.mdx` (the warn callout near line 86) says the schema accepts `tags` "but `os package publish` does not send them", which this PR makes false, and its key table omits `tags`. `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx` (near line 2955) lists `tagline` among the keys read and omits `tags`. Named in the `Skills-docs:` line as owed.
- The hosted bounds (20 tags, 64 characters each) are cloud's numbers and are not exported in this repository, so per the triage ruling the CLI does not pre-check them.
